scope: HMAC secret rotation, tamper detection, TRUNCATE bypass mitigation, payment gateway context guard
lens: cryptographic strength + secret hygiene + authorization gates + auditable trail
files_audited: app/Services/Fiscal/AuditLogService.php (especially L237-243 computeHash, L269-327 secretFor + assertProductionSafe)

I-1_sequence_monotonic_gap_free.evidence: Cache lock 'fiscal_seq_b{N}' + lockForUpdate prevents two cashiers allocating same seq. UNIQUE constraint orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique is the final gate — even on cache split-brain (Redis failover with replica drift) the DB unique key rejects fork. SQLite test driver uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE semantics that serialize.

I-2_hmac_chain_atomic.evidence: HMAC-SHA256 (FIPS-180-4) on canonical JSON with sorted keys (L335-374 canonicalise + sortRecursive). Per-branch secret via FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET_BRANCH_{id} env override (L273-277). hash_equals constant-time comparison at L223 (timing-attack resistant). UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) index rejects parallel fork at DB layer (L60-64 docblock confirms migration 2026_04_19_100000).

I-3_composition_snapshot_frozen.evidence: All 5 INSERT sites use json_encode (no string concat); copy-forward at refund preserves byte-exact bytes. No UPDATE statement found targeting composition_snapshot column. Tampering would require direct SQL bypass — which the audit_logs UPDATE trigger would catch on the related order.discount or order.refund.counter_entry audit row.

I-4_db_triggers_active.evidence: BEFORE UPDATE + BEFORE DELETE triggers on audit_logs (both MySQL SIGNAL + SQLite RAISE ABORT). BEFORE DELETE on z_reports (MySQL only — UPDATE intentionally allowed for state machine + cash enrichment). BEFORE DELETE on cash_movements + cash_drawer_sessions + order_payments. Triggers fire at storage-engine layer — un-bypassable by Eloquent OR raw SQL.

I-5_truncate_bypass_mitigation.evidence: docs/FISCAL_SECRETS.md exists at filesystem. Migration docblocks (audit_logs L138-140 + z_reports L29-30) explicitly call out TRUNCATE bypass + mitigation = revoke TRUNCATE permission via GRANT. This is correct: MySQL triggers do not fire on TRUNCATE by design — only DBA grant restriction prevents it. Cannot be enforced from migration.

security_findings.observation: Production-only refusal to sign with: (1) empty/missing secret, (2) known dev sentinels from fiscal.dev_sentinels config array, (3) secret shorter than fiscal.min_secret_length (default 32 chars). Three-pronged sentinel block + length floor + per-branch override = robust. Dev/test environments bypass for fast CI.

Recursive ksort on associative keys (lists preserved as-is via array_is_list check) — eliminates non-determinism from PHP array insertion order. JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES + JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE keep encoding stable across PHP 8.0+. Same algorithm reused for Z report signing via ksort($aggregates) at ZReportService L626.

[P0-POS-02 GOAL round-2 2026-05-18] PaymentService::payment() (which sets payment_status=PAID + creates Transaction row → fiscally-significant action) now requires the call stack to include a PaymentAbstract subclass frame. Non-spoofable from external controllers/jobs/CLI without inheriting the gateway hierarchy. Test escape hatch via app.bound('payment.service.allow_direct_call') with one-shot semantics (forgetInstance after consume) — cannot leak across tests.

[BYPASS-P2] BypassAuditLogger.paymentBypassed only logs HARDWARE bypass (TPE driver short-circuit). Fiscal invariants explicitly preserved (L15-19 docblock confirms: sealing fiscal NF525 + Outbox events + audit log + idempotency middleware all still run when payment.bypass.enabled=true). AppServiceProvider boot() abort() in production prevents bypass at runtime. No path observed where bypass mode could skip FiscalSequenceService::next or AuditLogService::write.

security_findings.location: AuditLogService L167-176 + ZReportService L253-265 + cron handler L183-203
security_findings.observation: All fiscal writes emit structured logs on dedicated 'fiscal' channel with hash_prefix (first 12 chars, not full HMAC). Payload itself NEVER logged (L165 explicit: 'never the payload because payloads may carry PII'). SIEM can correlate via audit_log_id + hash_prefix without decrypting. Daily cron at 03:30 sweeps every active branch, distinguishing chain.monitor.failure (non-zero exit per branch) vs chain.monitor.branch_error (per-branch throw) vs scheduler_error (top-level throw).

Wave 3 FISCAL-ADV3-02 + Wave 3b distinct exit codes: 0=OK, 1=TAMPER, 2=INVALID args (non-existent branch OR --branch=0 sentinel), 3=EXEC ERROR (DB outage / missing secret / unexpected throw). Allows monitoring to route NF525 breaches to compliance team and DB/cred issues to ops — different escalation paths, different on-call. Tamper priority > exec error in --all sweep (FAILURE wins over 3).

[POS-9-H.2.3 / F-C5] CLI/system writers MUST pass branch_id=0 explicitly (system chain) or positive int (tenant chain). Null branch_id rejected — without this guard a CLI job would poison whichever chain had the latest tail. Defense against developer mistake AND against malicious CLI replay.

keep_as_is: Recursive canonicalisation (ksort + JSON_UNESCAPED_*) for deterministic hash input
Production sentinel + min-length floor blocks weak secrets at write time
BypassAuditLogger limits bypass to hardware (no fiscal short-circuit)
Structured 'fiscal' log channel with hash_prefix only (no payload PII)
Distinct exit codes 0/1/2/3 for monitoring routing

summary: Cryptographic posture is correct (HMAC-SHA256 + deterministic canonical JSON + per-branch secret rotation + min-length + dev-sentinel block). Authorization gate on PaymentService::payment prevents non-gateway PAID promotion. Bypass mode is hardware-only — fiscal sealing always runs. TRUNCATE bypass mitigation is correctly delegated to DB GRANT level (docs/FISCAL_SECRETS.md exists). No security recommendations; KEEP-AS-IS.
